Agreed-Upon Procedures
Attest Team, HANGS Construction Services LLC Engagement · attest@finance-demo.example
ENGAGEMENT LETTER
To Cinderbrook Bank, Commercial Lending, and HANGS Construction Services LLC · Dated October 19, 2026
Re: Agreed-upon procedures on HANGS Construction Services LLC’s compliance with Sections 6.1, 6.5 and 7 of
the Loan Agreement with Cinderbrook Bank dated March 31, 2025, as amended March 31, 2026, as of June 30,
2026 and for the year then ended.
Cinderbrook Bank (the bank) engages the attest team to perform the procedures below. The bank and the borrower agree to
them and acknowledge that they are appropriate to assist the bank in evaluating the borrower’s compliance with those sections.
The borrower is responsible for its compliance and its records; the sufficiency of the procedures is the bank’s responsibility.
We will perform each procedure as written and report what we found. This is not an examination or a review: we express no
opinion or conclusion on compliance or on the financial statements. Terms have the meaning the Loan Agreement gives them. If
a definition does not decide a question, we will report the question and the amounts on each reading rather than choose one.
The procedures agreed
Procedure 1: Agree each balance in the FY2026 trial balance to the balance sheet at June 30, 2026 and the income statement for
the year in the borrower’s FY2026 financial statements, caption by caption, and report any difference.
Procedure 2: Agree each loan on the borrower’s debt schedule at June 30, 2026 to the trial balance and to the bank’s loan
confirmation: principal, rate, maturity and accrued interest. Recompute the principal due within twelve months from the payment
terms in Section 2 and agree interest expense to the trial balance.
Procedure 3: Compute working capital as Section 7.6 defines it from the balance sheet and compare it with the minimum in Section
7. Report the retainage receivable included in current assets.
Procedure 4: Compute tangible net worth as Section 7.6 defines it, deducting every amount due from an affiliate in the receivables
aging and the contract schedule, and compare it with the minimum in Section 7.
Procedure 5: Compute the ratio of total liabilities to tangible net worth as Section 7.6 defines it and compare it with the maximum in
Section 7.
Procedure 6: Total the FY2026 additions on the fixed asset register, agree them to account 1550, and compare Capital Expenditures
as Section 1.1 defines them with the limit in Section 6.5.
Procedure 7: Compare the dates the bank’s confirmation shows it received the June 30, 2026 compliance certificate and the FY2026
financial statements with the deadlines in Section 6.1.
Procedure 8: Compare each amount and ratio on the borrower’s June 30, 2026 compliance certificate with the results of procedures
3 to 6, and report any difference.
